title: Art. 3.7 — Annex 9 - Facilitation, Chapter 3 - Entry and Departure of Persons and Their Baggage, C. Security of travel documents, 3.7
content: Contracting States shall regularly update security features in new versions of their travel documents, to guard against their misuse and to facilitate detection of cases where such documents have been unlawfully altered, replicated or issued.
